description: The corpus run conformance/valid/completed-eval (copied to input/), the run of the OpenTelemetry round trip, as one Inspect EvalLog in .json form (inspect.json). Six samples, one per case, epoch 1; each line's score under its path, the typed absences and the inconclusive line without a score as NaN with the state in reason (IN-2); the AEF facts the table sends to Score.metadata under metadata.aef; usage per role and per model; the summary as results.scores (IN-3); the eval header Inspect requires (IN-1). Its overlays are left out (--ignore-overlays): the page refuses overlays (IN-4), and without the flag the converter refuses the run.
